definitions.explanation: A small model of a human figure.

examples.japanese: {娘|むすめ}に{人形|にんぎょう}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a doll for my daughter.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{伝統的|でんとうてき}な{人形|にんぎょう}です。
{人形|にんぎょう}で{遊|あそ}ぶ。
{祖母|そぼ}の{家|いえ}には{古|ふる}い{人形|にんぎょう}がたくさん{飾|かざ}ってある。
examples.english: At my grandmother's house, many old dolls are on display.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では3{月|がつ}3{日|にち}に{女|おんな}の{子|こ}のために{人形|にんぎょう}を{飾|かざ}る{習慣|しゅうかん}がある。
examples.english: In Japan, there's a custom of displaying dolls for girls on March 3rd.

notes:
{人形|にんぎょう} means doll, puppet, or figure - any small model of a human form.

TYPES OF DOLLS:
- ひな{人形|にんぎょう}: Hina dolls (for Girls' Day)
- {日本|にほん}{人形|にんぎょう}: traditional Japanese doll
- {操|あやつ}り{人形|にんぎょう}: puppet (marionette)
- ぬいぐるみ: stuffed animal/plush toy

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {人形|にんぎょう}で{遊|あそ}ぶ: to play with dolls
- {人形|にんぎょう}を{飾|かざ}る: to display dolls
- {人形|にんぎょう}{劇|げき}: puppet show

CULTURAL NOTE:
ひな{祭|まつ}り (Hinamatsuri/Girls' Day) on March 3rd features elaborate displays of ひな{人形|にんぎょう}, traditional dolls representing the imperial court.

RELATED:
- フィギュア: figure (loanword, for collectible figures)
